note: An example is every QA line in our byte-range reads of the training jsonl for one video. Each line is one question over the frame window [start_time, end_time] (seconds), with up to 64 sampled 1 fps frame paths (truncated here to 3). Answers of 'No, I can't respond for now.' teach the model to wait when the frames seen so far cannot answer. In the timeline the question spans the window and the answer is placed at end_time, which is our reading, not a field. No media: the LICENSE forbids redistribution, and the release has only 1 fps frames, no videos.

examples.title: videoic 13816168: poison dart frog documentary, 5 open questions about change over time

timeline.text: What change in the poison dart frog's appearance is highlighted between the first and second frames?
The color pattern shifts from vivid red and white to bright yellow and black.
What visual continuity can be observed from the first to the last frame regarding the camera work?
The camera remains steady and maintains a close-up focus on the frogs.
How does the environmental context shift from the second to the fifth frame?
The environment transitions from a humid rainforest backdrop to a more neutral, brown-toned setting.
What event occurs immediately after the frog is shown on the leaf in the third frame?
The frog is noted for its ability to communicate information about its environment.
In the final frames, what key aspect is discussed regarding the poison dart frogs?
Their dietary habits and safety measures for human interaction.
